pitch_en: Develops sustainable bio-based products from vegetable oil or biomass inputs, targeting agricultural value chain transformation and bioenergy solutions in Colombia.

sections.head_en: Used cooking oil and related organic waste streams are often disposed of improperly, contaminating soils and water while losing circular value.
sections.head_es: El aceite de cocina usado y flujos de residuos orgánicos relacionados a menudo se disponen inadecuadamente, contaminando suelos y agua mientras se pierde valor circular.
